phase_name: Phase 7 — structured error responses, middleware tests, CI/CD hardening
completed: Phase 1: Project foundation (.gitignore, Docker, docker-compose, Makefile, package structure, tests scaffold)
Phase 2: Real carbon API (electricitymap.org with cache+fallback), Redis queue, SQLite audit, CLI tool, CI workflow
Phase 3a: Systemd service file + install script + Makefile deploy targets
Fixed test infrastructure: pytest-asyncio version constraint, API test fixture, carbon API mock pattern
Phase 3b: Enhanced healthcheck endpoint (version, uptime, component checks) + Cloudflare tunnel config
Phase 3c: Prometheus /metrics endpoint + HTML monitoring dashboard
Phase 4a: In-memory rate limiting middleware with zero external deps (sliding window, burst control, X-RateLimit headers, 429 on exceed)
Phase 4b: API key authentication middleware (APIKeyAuth class, X-API-Key header, config/env-var keys, permissive dev mode, 8 new tests)
Phase 4c: Structured logging with structlog — centralized logging_config.py, request/response logging middleware, JSON/dev output, LOG_LEVEL/LOG_FORMAT env var overrides, 4 new tests

Phase 4d: Graceful shutdown / lifecycle hooks — LifecycleManager class, shared HTTPX client lifecycle, FastAPI shutdown event handler, Redis connection cleanup, CLI serve with timeout_graceful_shutdown, 9 new tests
Phase 5: K8s readiness probes + deployment manifests — /livez and /readyz endpoints, K8s Deployment/Service/Kustomization, 7 new tests, all exempt from auth and rate limiting
Phase 6: OpenAPI schema hardening — Pydantic response models with Field descriptions/examples for all endpoints, summary/description/tags/response metadata on every route, all 61 tests passing

Phase 7a: Structured error response models — ErrorResponse, ValidationErrorResponse, FieldError Pydantic models + global exception handlers (HTTPException, RequestValidationError, generic Exception) returning consistent JSON with status/detail/error_code fields

Phase 7b: Middleware tests — 14 new tests covering logging middleware (method/path/status/duration capture), auth edge cases (empty key, whitespace, lowercase header, exempt paths), rate-limit edge cases (burst via headers, window expiry, 429 response shape, exempt paths), validation error shape, 404/405 structured responses

Phase 7c: CI/CD hardening — .pre-commit-config.yaml (ruff, mypy, bandit, pre-commit-hooks), mypy + bandit config in pyproject.toml, dev dependency additions, Makefile targets (type-check, security-scan, pre-commit, install-dev), GitHub Actions workflow extended with mypy type-check and bandit security-scan steps
current: Phase 7: structured error responses, middleware tests, CI/CD hardening — done
